console-physical.note: the supported console / ten-foot path; PENDING_PHYSICAL (ledger XP-P2)

desktop-retail.note: the retail (non-Studio) desktop client; PENDING_PHYSICAL (ledger XP-P3)

phone-physical.note: the weakest supported physical Android device; PENDING_PHYSICAL (ledger XP-P1)

frameCeiling.note: Exceeding this proves the scene cannot hold the frame target on ANY supported device, because this host is faster than all of them. Passing it proves NOTHING about a device.

note: Headless trend budgets, floor-device (low-end Android) reference. observed_p95_ms is the WORST p95 over baselineRepeats runs, so the multiplier applies to a number that already contains the run-to-run jitter. total_p95_ms = max(worst_p95 × multiplier, floorMs). Trend-only; NOT a device SLA (§14.3).
